description: NaSrNdWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 3.02 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 3.02 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.95 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one Nd, and one W atom.
